one_sentence_argument: In ground-penetrating radar recognition, current executable evidence shows that environment and provenance structure can strongly reshape apparent generalization, with Res-SAM environment transfer providing the strongest cross-model support and Mojahid/4TU providing bounded secondary and stress-test evidence.
